lines.en: The grass goes flat under my foot
Carrying my gear, the road feels short

lines.zh: 我走过稀树草原，尘土跟着
lines.en: I cross the savanna and the dust follows

lines.zh: 慢点走，脚下的草里有刺
lines.en: Watch your step, the grass here has thorns
My steps are heavy, but the direction never changes

lines.zh: 这一队走在一起，谁敢挡
lines.en: We walk as a squad, who dares block us
A wooden door will not stop my boot

lines.zh: 我拖着长矛，尖儿刮着土
lines.en: I drag my spear and its point scrapes the dirt
The grass is so dry that walking is loud

lines.zh: 我走在前面，后面跟着人
lines.en: I take the front and the rest follow
The sun is fierce, and I walk on anyway

lines.zh: 离那群矮人还远，慢慢来
lines.en: The dwarves are still far off, no rush
I stand and plant my spear in the grass
This place bakes the energy out of a body
I count the smoke in the distance
The wind sets the grass to rustling
The shield on my back is a bit heavy
I wipe the meat scraps from my mouth
The trees are too sparse to hide anyone

lines.zh: 我往手上啐了一口，握紧矛
lines.en: I spit on my palms and grip the spear

lines.zh: 站着也在听，哪边有脚步
lines.en: I listen even while standing, where are the footsteps

lines.zh: 我揉了揉被晒红的鼻子
lines.en: I rub my sunburned nose

lines.zh: 这个角度的风，闻得到铁
lines.en: The wind from this angle carries iron
I hum a couple of notes, badly

lines.zh: 膝盖有点旧伤，站久了酸
lines.en: An old knee wound aches when I stand too long
The herds out there keep their distance

lines.zh: 我眯着眼看太阳的位置
lines.en: I squint to judge where the sun stands

lines.zh: 安静一会儿也好，等会儿就热闹
lines.en: Quiet for a while is fine, it will get loud soon

lines.zh: 我把手指关节一个个按响
lines.en: I crack my knuckles one by one
Grass seeds cling to my legs, I cannot be bothered
You are short and pale, clearly weak
I look down at you and have to bend my neck
Put the weapon down before you speak
You carry the smell of humans

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛，认过很多脸
lines.en: These eyes have memorized many faces

lines.zh: 站那儿别动，我看看你值多少
lines.en: Stand still, let me see what you are worth
You are holding that wrong
Smile, you will not get away anyway
I lift my chin for you to back off

lines.zh: 别找援兵了，草原一眼望到头
lines.en: Don't look for help, this savanna runs flat to the horizon
Send someone taller to talk to me

lines.zh: 这点个头，也敢走到我面前
lines.en: This small, and you walk up to me
That one, I will remember you
Thick hide, thick meat, keep swinging
I grunt and wipe the blood
It hurts, but I stay standing
That arm of yours has some use
This cut will need stitching later
I grit my teeth and tighten my grip
Try that again

lines.zh: 护甲挡了一半，剩下我扛着
lines.en: My armor took half the blow, I carry the rest
A small wound, do not make much of it
Meat? Hand it over, do not dawdle
I followed the smell over here
Keep that mouthful for yourself

lines.zh: 喂不饱我，但能拖一会儿
lines.en: It will not fill me, but it buys you a while

lines.zh: 你手抖什么，我又没咬你
lines.en: Why is your hand shaking, I have not bitten you
I snatch faster than you offer
One piece like this only lines the teeth
Is it cooked? I eat it raw too

lines.zh: 你给的东西，我得先看看
lines.en: What you offer, I look at first
Put it on the ground and step back three paces
Bump me? You must not need that shoulder

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你自己弹开
lines.en: I stand firm and you bounce off
Do not crowd, there is no room here

lines.zh: 我的盾牌侧面比正面硬
lines.en: The rim of my shield is harder than its face
You stepped on my foot
I put a hand out and push you aside
I take that shove as a greeting

lines.zh: 背后别贴人，我容易回身
lines.en: Do not stand at my back, I turn fast
The spear shaft blocked you sideways

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就不客气了
lines.en: Once more and I stop being polite
My mate has to carry her own load
You are too thin, one gust would drop you
That business needs the clan to agree

lines.zh: 我拍拍胸口，那是给人看的
lines.en: I thump my chest, that is for show
Let us share a meal of meat first

lines.zh: 别站那么近，我还没决定
lines.en: Do not stand so close, I have not decided
I lean in to sniff and then pull back

lines.zh: 草原上的伴，得能一起跑
lines.en: A mate on the savanna must keep pace

lines.zh: 我不太会说话，你别指望
lines.en: I am not much for words, do not expect any

lines.zh: 这个位置，我留给能打的
lines.en: This spot I keep for someone who can fight
I bend down and pick up the iron nuggets
What falls to the ground is mine by right
This bundle is tied up tight
I bite through the knot
There is not much coin in this gilded box
The meat fell, and I eat it anyway
I heave the thing up onto my shoulder
I am keeping this, do not reach for it

lines.zh: 矛得换手才能腾出来捡
lines.en: I have to switch the spear hand to pick it up
Done picking, my hands are dirty
Humans in sight, grab your weapons
I charge first, keep up
The dwarves over there are mine
I swing the spear around in front of me

lines.zh: 跑不掉的，草原没有遮挡
lines.en: You cannot escape, the savanna has no cover
My shout brings the others too
I see your shield, it will not help
This stretch belongs to us

lines.zh: 你来得正好，我刚活动开
lines.en: Good timing, I just warmed up
Do not count on those trees, they are too far
I chase you and do not let go
You turn, and I turn

lines.zh: 门后躲着也没用，我砸得开
lines.en: Hiding behind a door will not help, I break them

lines.zh: 跑得再快也跑不过马蹄
lines.en: Running will not outpace a horse

lines.zh: 我边跑边喊，让同族知道
lines.en: I shout as I run so my kin know

lines.zh: 你要往村里去？那里更糟
lines.en: Heading for the village? It is worse there
From here a spear throw would reach

lines.zh: 你把盾挪到左边，我记住了
lines.en: You shifted the shield left, I noted that
Your breathing is getting rougher

lines.zh: 别往石头上跑，我熟那块地
lines.en: Do not run for the rocks, I know that ground
The spear tip goes into the seam of your armor
I kick your shield aside
Now that I am close, your bow is useless
The blow lands and the ground shakes
The shield slams in, hold on
I grab you by the collar
This fist lands on your jaw
This is the same motion I use to break doors
When you step back, I press forward

lines.zh: 别倒了，我还想再来一下
lines.en: Do not fall yet, I want one more swing

lines.zh: 草原上多了面旗子，是我插的
lines.en: A banner now stands on the savanna, I planted it
I rise up out of the tall grass

lines.zh: 远处来了几个，都跟我一个样
lines.en: Several came from afar, all like me
Spear tip to the sky, consider it an announcement
Dust on the wind, and us with it

lines.zh: 这伙人一到，兽群就散了
lines.en: Our arrival scatters the herds
I strap the shield onto my back

lines.zh: 日头底下站开，影子排成一排
lines.en: Standing in the sun, our shadows line up
We hold a place even in daylight
I shout and the echo travels far

lines.zh: 打这儿经过的，最好绕路
lines.en: Anyone passing through should take another road
A new trail is crushed through the grass
The fire caught the grass and caught me

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候，盾先落地
lines.en: The shield hit first when I fell
The water is deep and I swim badly

lines.zh: 炸得我半边耳朵听不见
lines.en: The blast left half my hearing gone

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的肩，插得挺深
lines.en: An arrow sank into my shoulder, fairly deep

lines.zh: 那股味道钻进鼻子，脑子发昏
lines.en: That smell crawled up my nose and muddled my head
The meat ran out and my stomach is roaring

lines.zh: 一道雷下来，牙都咬紧了
lines.en: A lightning bolt and my teeth clenched shut

lines.zh: 这儿什么都没有，脚也踩不着
lines.en: There is nothing here, my feet find no ground
